tasks: Convert this Express.js API to NestJS TypeScript RESTful API
Set up a new NestJS project using the Nest CLI
Implement the necessary controllers, services, and modules
Use @nestjs packages like config, jwt, passport-local, etc.
Ensure proper error handling and validation - use class-validator and class-transformer, zod for env validation
Use TypeORM  with Postgres for database interactions
Document the API endpoints using Swagger
Use the @nestjs/swagger in the nest-cli.json, do not manually add Swagger decorators to the code
Ensure the application is structured according to NestJS best practices
Optimize the application for performance and scalability
Only focus on the backend implementation, no frontend code is required
expectedFeatures: CRUD operations for user management, bookings, tours, and reviews
API documentation with Swagger - nest-cli.json configuration
Error handling and validation for all endpoints
Database migrations and seeding with TypeORM
expectedOutput: A fully functional NestJS TypeScript RESTful API that meets the requirements specified in the tasks, with proper documentation and best practices followed.
notes: Ensure to follow the NestJS documentation for best practices and structure. Use the Nest CLI for project setup and management. Focus on backend implementation only, no frontend code is required. Write clean, DRY, and maintainable code. Use environment variables for configuration and sensitive data management.
